scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=client run build && npm --workspace=server run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=client run lint && npm --workspace=server run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace=client run test && npm --workspace=server run test
